question: How should we talk to someone whose payment just failed?
notes: This is the highest-traffic error in the product and it sets the register for every other message we write. Same information in both; only the voice differs.
how: Read them out loud. One of them sounds like a person who is on your side, and one sounds like a company protecting itself. Pick the register you want the whole product to have.

map.A: plain and human, no apology, action first

blocks.title: card declined
blocks.text:
Your bank declined the payment.

They do not tell us why, but it is usually a temporary block. Try again, or use a different card — nothing has been charged.

blocks.title: expired card
blocks.text: That card expired in March. Add a new one and we will pick up where you left off.

blocks.title: insufficient funds
blocks.text: There was not enough in the account to cover it. Nothing was charged. Try another card whenever you are ready.

blocks.title: card declined
blocks.text:
We're sorry — we were unable to process your payment at this time.

Your financial institution declined the transaction. Please verify your payment details and try again, or contact your card issuer for more information.

blocks.title: expired card
blocks.text: We're sorry — the card on file has expired and can no longer be used. Please update your payment method to continue your subscription.

blocks.title: insufficient funds
blocks.text: We're sorry — your payment could not be completed due to insufficient funds. Please ensure sufficient funds are available and try again.
